title: Ret / Shadow / Holy Paladin vs Thug
summary: You hold 20 answers to their 17 and two Paladins with eight each. Win the long one — but your Shadow Priest has to survive it.

sections.title: The clock is yours; your Shadow Priest is the exception
sections.body: Counts, yours: Ret 8, Holy 8, Shadow 4. Theirs: Rogue 6, Hunter 6, Priest 5. Two Paladins with three immunities each between them means their go has to be perfect and yours does not. The whole matchup is whether your Shadow Priest — four answers, no escape, no interrupt — lives through the two or three real attempts they get.

sections.title: Opener — protect the Priest before you attack

steps.note: 25s. Pre-emptive on the Priest, not reactive.
30s on the Rogue. It repeats every go.
30s. Only once they have committed to reaching you.

sections.title: The go — on their Priest, every 60 seconds

steps.note: 60s. Aligned to Wrath, not spread from it.
30s. Inside the window, on their healer.
240s. Physical immunity — it blanks the Rogue.
60s. The cheap one; spend it first.
12s. The opener, and it is on your Priest.
25s. Lands on a Paladin, not the kill target.
30s. The window — this is when the trinket goes.
